text_en: Fifa World Cup, Portugal vs Ghana C.Ronaldo : Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo, the best footballers in the world, have won many titles for their clubs and countries, but neither of them has a World Cup to their name. The World Cup being played in Qatar is possibly the last for both of them, and both want to see a World Cup in their trophy cabinet. So both are trying hard. Argentina, however, had to concede defeat to Saudi Arabia in their very first match, and today all eyes were on Ronaldo in the match. In it, Ronaldo had scored a brilliant goal to give Portugal the lead, but the referee disallowed it. Following this, Portugal's fans registered their protest on social media. Ghana had faced off against them, and Portugal had won 2-1. In that match Cristiano Ronaldo had scored the winning goal. In 2006 they had won their last knockout-round match (1-0 vs Netherlands). Everyone is curious about how Ronaldo performs in what may be the final World Cup of his career, and whether he lifts the trophy. In the match against Ghana, Ronaldo played in the first half in a manner befitting his reputation, but Portugal could not score. In the 31st minute Cristiano Ronaldo scored, but because he pushed a Ghana player to win the ball, the referee ruled the goal out. Bhubaneswar, 2.9: The new and exclusive outlet of the country's leading shoes and accessories brand Mochi has been formally inaugurated at Esplanade One Mall in Rasulgarh, Bhubaneswar. On this occasion, Parthapratim Nayak, Centre Head of Esplanade One Mall, joined as the guest of honour and inaugurated it. Others present included Mochi's RM Unsbar Sahani, City Manager Irfan Alli, outlet (showroom) manager S.K. Soaib and others. In particular, the Mochi store has started operations at Shop No. 1 on the ground floor of Esplanade One Mall. In this context, an inaugural store offer has been announced. Customers can even get a flat 20% discount on all Mochi shoes and accessories brand products, the store said. This offer ends on Saturday (2 September 2023).

Among the many positive and negative aspects of the New Education Policy, 2020, the country's policymakers should also include current challenges. Manish JaisalAmong the many positive and negative aspects of the New Education Policy, 2020, the country's policymakers should also include current challenges. The situation is that even though media education has existed in the country for more than a hundred years, people are seen becoming participants in bloodshed on the strength of a much-publicised message. Given that India, a large democratic country, is striving to bring its education system to an international level, what could be more pleasing for its citizens! With the goal that every student develops comprehensively with their distinctive abilities and identity, and builds basic literacy and conceptual understanding, the Government of India decided last year to implement the New Education Policy. This multidimensional action plan was made keeping in view Goal four of the Sustainable Development Agenda 2030 adopted in 2015, which proposes a global education development agenda. It accepts the aim of ensuring inclusive and equitable quality education for all by 2030 and promoting lifelong learning opportunities. The health of any society can be judged by the availability of accessible education systems for its students. Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar, who gave the country the largest written constitution in the world, struggled with the crisis of this very system during his student life. Despite this, he became famous among the world's renowned personalities through his work. At the start of the New Education Policy it is made clear that flexibility, multilingualism, ethics, humanity, constitutional values, life skills, connection with the roots of Indianness, etc. will be adopted prominently. That is why, along with Indian languages, the study of Korean, German, Portuguese, Russian and other foreign languages will also be arranged, so that a student can understand the global scenario through a related language.Among the points given prominence in framing the New Education Policy, 2020 is teaching children words, sounds, colours, shapes, numbers, etc. from class one itself. Although much of this can be taught to students in smart classrooms in exchange for the expensive fees charged by private schools, it should be clear how the government views this point amid the dilapidated system of government schools. It is no secret even today how a primary-school teacher explains the difference between 'स', 'श' and 'ष' to students. Until a teacher, confused between the 'स' that resembles a sarota (betel-nut cutter) and the hexagon-shaped 'ष', expresses the sound correctly in that primary class, how will the student grow up to become a good learner of Indian languages? Mother Killed Infant: A display of a mother's cruelty has been witnessed in Kolkata. Here a woman gave birth to a child in the toilet of her house and then herself took its life. The incident is reported to be from 22 April. The woman gave birth to the child and then, hearing the sound of its crying, got frightened. Then she threw the newborn out of the window.The accused woman says she did not know she was pregnant. She was having her periods as on normal days. In such a situation, when she went to the washroom and suddenly gave birth to the child, she was stunned. Seeing the baby she became frightened, broke the window glass and threw the child outside.Is the woman mentally unstable?A police officer said that when neighbours heard the sound of the window glass breaking, they reached the spot. Seeing the newborn lying covered in blood on the ground, the neighbours informed the police. On the other hand, blood was also flowing from the lower part of the woman's body. The woman and her children have been admitted to hospital. However, the child died. It is being said that the woman is mentally unstable and no one in the family knew about her pregnancy.According to the officer, the woman had been living in a live-in relationship since June 2022 and got married in November. The woman's husband is also a drunkard. Police are now investigating the whole matter, and a case has been registered against the woman under the IPC section (an act done with the intention of preventing the child from being born alive or causing its death after birth).Note: You can download our app to read Punjabi breaking news.If you want to watch videos, subscribe to the YouTube channel of ABP Sanjha. So during the summer holidays many people want to play various water games to get relief from the heat. Instead of just going to hill stations in summer, going to places where you can play various thrilling water games can be a good option. So we have brought information about five such places where you can enjoy water games. Here you can also enjoy white-water rafting. Kayaking and coracle rides also give you thrilling experiences. It is a perfect destination to relieve stress, away from the hectic life.au)A cruise experience on the Hooghly river in Kolkata will bring a new energy into your life. During this cruise ride you will move away from the fast pace of the city and be able to enjoy the natural life of rural areas. You can also go gliding on the Hooghly river. You can wander in the rural areas of Mayapur. In the rushing waters of this river you will surely get an exciting experience. During rafting here you can also tour hilly areas and tribal hamlets. This is one of the best options to see the natural beauty of Kerala up close. Here you can start your journey from Alleppey and reach Chappu, Pulikunnu, Kavalam Island and Kovilakom, visiting villages along the way. You can also stay in heritage villas here and enjoy the backwaters. Havelock Island is considered the best here for scuba diving. If you are not interested in scuba diving, you can still enjoy seeing various sea creatures here. The water games experienced here during your vacation will be ones you remember for a lifetime.
